BiblicalUsage: The word is an escape, and it appears once, in David's cry to be far away from the storm: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the escape David wanted was not from God's will but from men's violence, and God is the shelter he was running toward.
